# WellSource — Health & Wellness Blog

## Overview

Build the homepage for **WellSource**, a trusted health and wellness media platform. Think WebMD meets a modern editorial blog — authoritative yet approachable. The audience is everyday consumers looking for reliable health information, so the design must immediately communicate **credibility and warmth** without feeling clinical or cold.

## Visual Direction

- **Color palette**: Use a calming, health-oriented scheme — soft teals/greens as primary, warm whites and light grays for backgrounds, with accents of coral or amber for CTAs. Avoid harsh reds or overly saturated colors.
- **Typography**: Clean, modern sans-serif (e.g., Inter, DM Sans, or similar) with strong hierarchy. Headlines should feel confident; body text should be highly readable at comfortable sizes.
- **Mood**: Professional but human. Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, subtle shadows. The page should feel like a well-organized magazine — content-rich without being overwhelming.

## Key Priorities

1. **Trust is everything.** The credibility stats ticker and trust pillars section are critical — these must feel prominent and polished. The scrolling ticker with stats like "130 medical reviewers" and "50 million monthly readers" should be eye-catching and smooth.

2. **The mega-menu navigation** is a core interaction. Each main nav item should expand a well-structured dropdown with subcategories. This is how users discover content — make it intuitive and visually clean.

3. **Recommended Reads tabs** are the primary interactive content discovery mechanism. The tab switching between categories (Top Reads, Fitness, Mental Well-Being, etc.) must feel snappy and seamless, updating the article grid below without page reload.

4. **Newsletter signup** should be visually compelling — this is a key conversion goal. Make the CTA section stand out with a contrasting background.

5. **Health topics carousel** should scroll smoothly with clear navigation arrows and attractive circular image cards.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the complete section list, all interaction specs, and detailed data content.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

React framework with SSR, SSG, RSC, and optimization features **Turborepo** - High-performance monorepo build system for JavaScript/TypeScript **RemixIcon** - Icon library with 3,100+ outlined and filled style icons ## When to Use This Skill Group - Building new full-stack web applications with modern React - Setting up monorepos with multiple apps and shared packages - Implementing server-side rendering and static generation - Optimizing build performance with intelligent caching - Creating consistent UI with professional iconography - Managing workspace dependencies across multiple projects - Deploying production-ready applications with proper optimization ## Stack Selection Guide ### Single Application: Next.js + RemixIcon Use when building a standalone application: - E-commerce sites - Marketing websites - SaaS applications - Documentation sites - Blogs and content platforms **Setup:** ```bash npx create-next-app@latest my-app cd my-app npm install remixicon ``` ### Monorepo: Next.js + Turborepo + RemixIcon Use when building multiple applications with shared code: - Microfrontends - Multi-tenant platforms - Internal tools with shared component library - Multiple apps (web, admin, mobile-web) sharing logic - Design system with documentation site **Setup:** ```bash npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo # Then configure Next.js apps in apps/ directory # Install remixicon in shared UI packages ``` ### Framework Features Comparison | Feature | Next.js | Turborepo | RemixIcon | |---------|---------|-----------|-----------| | Primary Use | Web framework | Build system | UI icons | | Best For | SSR/SSG apps | Monorepos | Consistent iconography | | Performance | Built-in optimization | Caching & parallel tasks | Lightweight fonts/SVG | | TypeScript | Full support | Full support | Type definitions available | ## Quick Start ### Next.js Application ```bash # Create new project npx create-next-app@latest my-app cd my-app # Install RemixIcon npm install remixicon # Import in layout # app/layout.tsx import 'remixicon/fonts/remixicon.css' # Start development npm run dev ``` ### Turborepo Monorepo ```bash # Create monorepo npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo cd my-monorepo # Structure: # apps/web/ - Next.js application # apps/docs/ - Documentation site # packages/ui/ - Shared components with RemixIcon # packages/config/ - Shared configs # turbo.json - Pipeline configuration # Run all apps npm run dev # Build all packages npm run build ``` ### RemixIcon Integration ```tsx // Webfont (HTML/CSS) // React component import { RiHomeLine, RiSearchFill } from "@remixicon/react" ``` ## Reference Navigation **Next.js References:** - [App Router Architecture](./references/nextjs-app-router.md) - Routing, layouts, pages, parallel routes - [Server Components](./references/nextjs-server-components.md) - RSC patterns, client vs server, streaming - [Data Fetching](./references/nextjs-data-fetching.md) - fetch API, caching, revalidation, loading states - [Optimization](./references/nextjs-optimization.md) - Images, fonts, scripts, bundle analysis, PPR **Turborepo References:** - [Setup & Configuration](./references/turborepo-setup.md) - Installation, workspace config, package structure - [Task Pipelines](./references/turborepo-pipelines.md) - Dependencies, parallel execution, task ordering - [Caching Strategies](./references/turborepo-caching.md) - Local cache, remote cache, cache invalidation **RemixIcon References:** - [Integration Guide](./references/remix-icon-integration.md) - Installation, usage, customization, accessibility ## Common Patterns & Workflows ### Pattern 1: Full-Stack Monorepo ``` my-monorepo/ ├── apps/ │ ├── web/ # Customer-facing Next.js app │ ├── admin/ # Admin dashboard Next.js app │ └── docs/ # Documentation site ├── packages/ │ ├── ui/ # Shared UI with RemixIcon │ ├── api-client/ # API client library │ ├── config/ # ESLint, TypeScript configs │ └── types/ # Shared TypeScript types └── turbo.json # Build pipeline ``` **turbo.json:** ```json { "$schema": "https://turbo.build/schema.json", "pipeline": { "build": { "dependsOn": ["^build"], "outputs": [".next/**", "!.next/cache/**", "dist/**"] }, "dev": { "cache": false, "persistent": true }, "lint": {}, "test": { "dependsOn": ["build"] } } } ``` ### Pattern 2: Shared Component Library ```tsx // packages/ui/src/button.tsx import { RiLoader4Line } from "@remixicon/react" export function Button({ children, loading, icon }) { return ( ) } // apps/web/app/page.tsx import { Button } from "@repo/ui/button" import { RiHomeLine } from "@remixicon/react" export default function Page() { return } ``` ### Pattern 3: Optimized Data Fetching ```tsx // app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx import { notFound } from 'next/navigation' // Static generation at build time export async function generateStaticParams() { const posts = await getPosts() return posts.map(post => ({ slug: post.slug })) } // Revalidate every hour async function getPost(slug: string) { const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/posts/${slug}`, { next: { revalidate: 3600 } }) if (!res.ok) return null return res.json() } export default async function Post({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) { const post = await getPost(params.slug) if (!post) notFound() return
{post.content}
} ``` ### Pattern 4: Monorepo CI/CD Pipeline ```yaml # .github/workflows/ci.yml name: CI on: [push, pull_request] jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: 18 - run: npm install - run: npx turbo run build test lint env: TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }} TURBO_TEAM: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TEAM }} ``` ## Utility Scripts Python utilities in `scripts/` directory: **nextjs-init.py** - Initialize Next.js project with best practices **turborepo-migrate.py** - Convert existing monorepo to Turborepo Usage examples: ```bash # Initialize new Next.js app with TypeScript and recommended setup python scripts/nextjs-init.py --name my-app --typescript --app-router # Migrate existing monorepo to Turborepo with dry-run python scripts/turborepo-migrate.py --path ./my-monorepo --dry-run # Run tests cd scripts/tests pytest ``` ## Best Practices **Next.js:** - Default to Server Components, use Client Components only when needed - Implement proper loading and error states - Use Image component for automatic optimization - Set proper metadata for SEO - Leverage caching strategies (force-cache, revalidate, no-store) **Turborepo:** - Structure monorepo with clear separation (apps/, packages/) - Define task dependencies correctly (^build for topological) - Configure outputs for proper caching - Enable remote caching for team collaboration - Use filters to run tasks on changed packages only **RemixIcon:** - Use line style for minimal interfaces, fill for emphasis - Maintain 24x24 grid alignment for crisp rendering - Provide aria-labels for accessibility - Use currentColor for flexible theming - Prefer webfonts for multiple icons, SVG for single icons ## Resources - Next.js: https://nextjs.org/docs/llms.txt - Turborepo: https://turbo.build/repo/docs - RemixIcon: https://remixicon.com ## Implementation Checklist Building with this stack: - [ ] Implement routing and layouts - [ ] Add loading and error states - [ ] Configure image and font optimization - [ ] Set up data fetching patterns - [ ] Configure caching strategies - [ ] Add API routes as needed - [ ] Implement shared component library (if monorepo) - [ ] Configure remote caching (if monorepo) - [ ] Set up CI/CD pipeline - [ ] Configure deployment platform "}

1	# WellSource — Expert health guidance you can trust
2	
3	## Brand
4	WellSource is a comprehensive health and wellness media platform delivering medically reviewed content, tools, and resources to empower informed health decisions. The tone is professional, modern, and warm — designed to build trust with general consumers seeking reliable health and wellness information.
5	
6	Brand colors: #02838D (teal/primary), #231F20 (dark charcoal), #FFFFFF (white)
7	
8	## Header Navigation

# WellSource — Expert health guidance you can trust

## Brand
WellSource is a comprehensive health and wellness media platform delivering medically reviewed content, tools, and resources to empower informed health decisions. The tone is professional, modern, and warm — designed to build trust with general consumers seeking reliable health and wellness information.

Brand colors: #02838D (teal/primary), #231F20 (dark charcoal), #FFFFFF (white)

## Header Navigation
- **Health Conditions** — dropdown mega-menu with subcategories: Breast Cancer, Chronic Kidney Disease, COPD, Digestive Health, Eye Health, Heart Health, Menopause, Mental Health, Migraine, Multiple Sclerosis, Parkinson's Disease, Psoriasis, Rheumatoid Arthritis, Sleep Health, Type 2 Diabetes, Weight Management
- **Wellness** — dropdown with: CBD, Fitness, Healthy Aging, Hearing, Mental Well-Being, Nutrition, Parenthood, Recipes, Sexual Health, Skin Care, Sleep Health, Vitamins and Supplements, Women's Wellness; also Product Reviews and Featured Programs
- **Tools** — Pill Identifier, FindCare, Drugs A-Z, Medicare Plans by State, Lessons, Newsletters, Lifestyle Quizzes
- **Featured** — Health News, Top Reads, Video Series
- **Connect** — Bezzy community links, social media

Secondary actions: Subscribe | Sign In

## Credibility Stats
A continuously scrolling ticker bar displaying:
- Medically reviewed content
- 145 medical reviewers in network
- 21 years of experience
- 55 million monthly readers

Category label: Fitness

Visual context: 30-day fitness challenge badge

Heading: "The best of health and wellness"

Input: Email field
CTA: "Join Now"
Privacy note: "Your privacy is important to us."

## Health Topics
Horizontally scrollable card carousel with circular images:
- Anxiety & Depression
- Digestive Health
- Heart Health
- Menopause
- Type 2 Diabetes
- Weight Management

Action: "View all" link

## Health Tools
### Nutrition Hub
Heading: "Healthy eating, simplified"
Body: "Take charge of your nutrition with guidance on meal planning, diets, supplements, and more from our dietitians and nutritionists."
CTA: "Visit Nutrition Hub"

Tools list:
- **Recipe Hub** — Try 400+ recipes for different dietary preferences
- **Macronutrient Calculator** — Calculate your daily carb, protein, and fat goals

Tabbed category filters: Top Reads | Fitness | Mental Well-Being | Product Reviews | Recipes | Skin Care

Articles displayed:
- 16 Superfoods That Are Worthy of the Title

- Can Music Therapy Help with Depression?
- Why Am I Craving So Much Salt?
- These Are the 8 Best Calorie Counter Apps

## Trust Pillars
Section heading: "Why you can trust us on your health journey"

- **For you, by experts** — Experienced health writers break down complex topics so your choices feel clearer.
- **Built to move you forward** — We pair trusted information with tools and resources to guide your real health decisions.
- **Reviewed by professionals** — Content accuracy checked by our medical experts so information is always dependable.
- **Always up to date** — We regularly update our content as medical guidance evolves, so your next steps reflect what's current.

## Featured Programs
Cards linking to curated editorial programs (with "View all" link):

Newsletter signup: "Filter out the noise and nurture your inbox with health and wellness advice that's inclusive and rooted in medical expertise."
Email input + "Sign Up" button

Legal: "© 2026 WellSource Media LLC. All rights reserved. Our website services, content, and products are for informational purposes only. WellSource does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment."

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>WellSource — Expert health guidance you can trust</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..40,300;0,9..40,400;0,9..40,500;0,9..40,600;0,9..40,700;1,9..40,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/remixicon@4.5.0/fonts/remixicon.css" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --teal: #02838D;
      --teal-dark: #016b74;
      --teal-light: #e6f5f6;
      --teal-mid: #b3dde0;
      --charcoal: #231F20;
      --charcoal-light: #4a4547;
      --coral: #E8654A;
      --amber: #F5A623;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --gray-50: #F8FAFB;
      --gray-100: #F1F4F5;
      --gray-200: #E2E8EA;
      --gray-300: #C9D3D6;
      --gray-500: #7A8A8D;
      --gray-700: #3D4A4C;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 20px;
      --radius-xl: 28px;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 4px rgba(2,131,141,0.08);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 16px rgba(2,131,141,0.12);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 32px rgba(2,131,141,0.16);
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-size: 16px;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
    button { cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; border: none; background: none; }

    .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
    .container-wide { max-width: 1360px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

    /* ─── TICKER ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .ticker-bar {
      background: var(--teal);
      color: white;
      padding: 10px 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }
    .ticker-bar::before,
    .ticker-bar::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; bottom: 0;
      width: 80px;
      z-index: 2;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .ticker-bar::before { left: 0; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--teal), transparent); }
    .ticker-bar::after  { right: 0; background: linear-gradient(to left, var(--teal), transparent); }

    .ticker-track {
      display: flex;
      width: max-content;
      animation: ticker-scroll 28s linear infinite;
    }
    .ticker-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }

    @keyframes ticker-scroll {
      0%   { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    .ticker-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 0 48px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 500;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .ticker-item i {
      font-size: 16px;
      opacity: 0.9;
    }
    .ticker-sep {
      width: 5px; height: 5px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* ─── HEADER / NAV ───────────────────────────────────────── */
    .site-header {
      background: white;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    }
    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0;
      height: 68px;
    }
    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--teal);
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-right: 32px;
    }
    .logo-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      background: var(--teal);
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .logo-icon i { color: white; font-size: 20px; }
    .logo span { color: var(--charcoal); }
    .logo span em { color: var(--teal); font-style: normal; }

    .main-nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .nav-item {
      position: relative;
    }
    .nav-link {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      font-size: 14.5px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--charcoal-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .nav-link i { font-size: 13px; transition: transform 0.2s; }
    .nav-item:hover > .nav-link,
    .nav-item.active > .nav-link { color: var(--teal); background: var(--teal-light); }
    .nav-item:hover > .nav-link i { transform: rotate(180deg); }

    /* Mega dropdown */
    .mega-menu {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 8px);
      left: -16px;
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      padding: 20px;
      min-width: 560px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s, visibility 0.2s;
      z-index: 200;
    }
    .mega-menu.narrow { min-width: 280px; }
    .nav-item:hover .mega-menu { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0); }

    .mega-menu-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .mega-menu-grid.col2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

    .mega-link {
      display: block;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: var(--charcoal-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    }
    .mega-link:hover { color: var(--teal); background: var(--teal-light); }

    .mega-section-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      padding: 0 10px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }
    .mega-section-title:first-child { margin-top: 0; }

    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-left: 16px;
    }
    .btn-signin {
      padding: 8px 18px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--teal);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--teal-mid);
      border-radius: 40px;
      transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    }
    .btn-signin:hover { background: var(--teal-light); border-color: var(--teal); }
    .btn-subscribe {
      padding: 8px 20px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: white;
      background: var(--teal);
      border-radius: 40px;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
    }
    .btn-subscribe:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* ─── HERO ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .hero {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #012f32 0%, #01565c 50%, #02838d 100%);
      padding: 64px 0 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.03'%3E%3Cpath d='M36 34v-4h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2h-4zm0-30V0h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2V6h4V4h-4zM6 34v-4H4v4H0v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2H6zM6 4V0H4v4H0v2h4v4h2V6h4V4H6z'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    }
    .hero-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 340px;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: end;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-content { padding-bottom: 64px; }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      padding: 5px 14px;
      border-radius: 40px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero-badge i { font-size: 13px; color: var(--amber); }
    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 520px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: white;
      color: var(--teal);
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: 40px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    }
    .hero-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }
    .hero-challenge-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl) 0 0;
      padding: 28px 28px 0;
      box-shadow: 0 -8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      align-self: end;
    }
    .challenge-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: var(--teal-light);
      color: var(--teal);
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border-radius: 40px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .challenge-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 200px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e6f5f6 0%, #b3dde0 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .challenge-img-inner {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--teal);
    }
    .challenge-img-inner i { font-size: 56px; opacity: 0.7; }
    .challenge-day {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
      opacity: 0.8;
    }
    .challenge-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      margin-top: 14px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .challenge-progress {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 12px;
      padding-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .progress-bar {
      flex: 1;
      height: 5px;
      background: var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 40px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .progress-fill {
      width: 40%;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--teal);
      border-radius: 40px;
    }
    .progress-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-500); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ─── TRENDING ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .trending-section {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      padding: 28px 0;
    }
    .trending-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .trending-label {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: var(--coral);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .trending-label i { font-size: 15px; }
    .trending-divider {
      width: 1px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--gray-300);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .trending-list {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .trending-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 40px;

    .trending-item:hover { border-color: var(--teal-mid); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
    .trending-tag {

    .trending-title { font-size: 13px; color: var(--charcoal-light); font-weight: 400; }

    /* ─── NEWSLETTER CTA ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .newsletter-cta {

    }

    }

    .topic-card {

  // ── Recommended Reads Tabs ──────────────────────────────────
  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.reads-tab');
  const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel');

  tabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const target = tab.dataset.tab;

      tabs.forEach(t => {
        t.classList.remove('active');
        t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
      });
      panels.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));

      tab.classList.add('active');
      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      const panel = document.getElementById('tab-' + target);
      if (panel) panel.classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  // ── Health Topics Carousel ──────────────────────────────────
  const track = document.getElementById('topicsTrack');
  const prev  = document.getElementById('topicsPrev');
  const next  = document.getElementById('topicsNext');
  const SCROLL = 160;

  prev.addEventListener('click', () => track.scrollBy({ left: -SCROLL, behavior: 'smooth' }));
  next.addEventListener('click', () => track.scrollBy({ left:  SCROLL, behavior: 'smooth' }));

  // ── Newsletter forms (prevent default) ─────────────────────
  document.querySelectorAll('.form-row, .footer-form').forEach(form => {
    const btn = form.querySelector('button');
    if (btn) {

        if (input && input.value.trim()) {

          btn.style.background = '#27AE60';
          input.value = '';

            btn.textContent = btn.classList.contains('btn-join') ? 'Join Now' : 'Sign Up';
            btn.style.background = '';
          }, 3000);
        }
      });
    }
  });
</script>

      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .progress-fill {
      width: 40%;

      background: var(--teal);

    }
    .progress-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-500); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ─── TRENDING ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .trending-section {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      padding: 28px 0;
    }
    .trending-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .trending-label {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: var(--coral);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .trending-label i { font-size: 15px; }
    .trending-divider {
      width: 1px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--gray-300);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .trending-list {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .trending-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 40px;
      transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
    }
    .trending-item:hover { border-color: var(--teal-mid); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
    .trending-tag {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
      background: var(--teal-light);
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 40px;
    }
    .trending-title { font-size: 13px; color: var(--charcoal-light); font-weight: 400; }

    /* ─── NEWSLETTER CTA ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .newsletter-cta {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-dark) 0%, var(--teal) 100%);
      padding: 56px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .newsletter-cta::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -80px; right: -80px;
      width: 320px; height: 320px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }
    .newsletter-cta::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -60px; left: -60px;
      width: 240px; height: 240px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    }
    .newsletter-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 48px;
    }
    .newsletter-text { flex: 1; }
    .newsletter-text h2 {
      font-size: 28px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
    }
    .newsletter-text p {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      max-width: 440px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .newsletter-form { flex: 0 0 400px; }
    .form-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0;
      background: white;
      border-radius: 40px;
      padding: 4px 4px 4px 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .form-row input {
      flex: 1;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      font-size: 14.5px;
      font-family: inherit;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      background: transparent;
    }
    .form-row input::placeholder { color: var(--gray-500); }
    .btn-join {
      padding: 10px 22px;
      background: var(--coral);
      color: white;
      border-radius: 40px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .btn-join:hover { background: #d4563a; transform: scale(1.02); }
    .privacy-note {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
    }
    .privacy-note i { font-size: 13px; }

    /* ─── HEALTH TOPICS ──────────────────────────────────────── */
    .section { padding: 64px 0; }
    .section-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
    }
    .section-title span { color: var(--teal); }
    .view-all {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
      transition: gap 0.15s;
    }
    .view-all:hover { gap: 8px; }
    .view-all i { font-size: 15px; }

    .carousel-wrapper { position: relative; }
    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
      padding: 8px 4px;
    }
    .carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .topic-card {
      flex: 0 0 140px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .topic-circle {
      width: 112px;
      height: 112px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 3px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
    }
    .topic-card:hover .topic-circle {
      border-color: var(--teal);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(2,131,141,0.2);
    }
    .topic-circle-bg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .topic-circle-bg i { font-size: 44px; }
    .tc-anxiety   .topic-circle-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EDE9FE, #DDD6FE); }
    .tc-anxiety   .topic-circle-bg i { color: #7C3AED; }
    .tc-digestive .topic-circle-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FEF3C7, #FDE68A); }
    .tc-digestive .topic-circle-bg i { color: #D97706; }
    .tc-heart     .topic-circle-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE4E6, #FECDCd); }
    .tc-heart     .topic-circle-bg i { color: #E11D48; }
    .tc-menopause .topic-circle-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FCE7F3, #FBCFE8); }
    .tc-menopause .topic-circle-bg i { color: #BE185D; }
    .tc-diabetes  .topic-circle-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E6F5F6, var(--teal-mid)); }
    .tc-diabetes  .topic-circle-bg i { color: var(--teal-dark); }
    .tc-weight    .topic-circle-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D1FAE5, #A7F3D0); }
    .tc-weight    .topic-circle-bg i { color: #065F46; }

    .topic-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .topic-card:hover .topic-label { color: var(--teal); }

    .carousel-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: white;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      color: var(--charcoal);
      font-size: 18px;
      transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, transform 0.15s;
      z-index: 10;
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover {
      background: var(--teal);
      border-color: var(--teal);
      color: white;
      transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.05);
    }
    .carousel-btn.prev { left: -20px; }
    .carousel-btn.next { right: -20px; }

    /* ─── TOOLS ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .tools-section { background: var(--gray-50); padding: 64px 0; }
    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 28px;
    }
    .nutrition-hub {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal) 0%, var(--teal-dark) 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 36px;
      color: white;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .nutrition-hub::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -40px; right: -40px;
      width: 180px; height: 180px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }
    .nutrition-hub-icon {
      width: 52px; height: 52px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .nutrition-hub-icon i { font-size: 26px; color: white; }
    .nutrition-hub h3 { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; }
    .nutrition-hub p { font-size: 14.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .btn-hub {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      background: white;
      color: var(--teal);
      padding: 11px 22px;
      border-radius: 40px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .btn-hub:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }
    .nutrition-tools { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .nutrition-tool-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 12px 14px;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }
    .nutrition-tool-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); }
    .nutrition-tool-item i { font-size: 18px; opacity: 0.85; }
    .nutrition-tool-text strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; display: block; }
    .nutrition-tool-text span { font-size: 12.5px; opacity: 0.75; }

    .drug-tools { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
    .drug-tool-card {
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 18px 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 14px;
      transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.15s;
    }
    .drug-tool-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--teal-mid);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .drug-tool-icon {
      width: 42px; height: 42px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .drug-tool-icon i { font-size: 20px; }
    .icon-teal { background: var(--teal-light); }
    .icon-teal i { color: var(--teal); }
    .icon-amber { background: #FEF3C7; }
    .icon-amber i { color: #D97706; }
    .icon-coral { background: #FFF1EE; }
    .icon-coral i { color: var(--coral); }
    .icon-purple { background: #F3F0FF; }
    .icon-purple i { color: #6D28D9; }
    .drug-tool-content { flex: 1; }
    .drug-tool-content strong { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--charcoal); display: block; margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .drug-tool-content p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-500); line-height: 1.4; }
    .drug-tool-cta {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .drug-tool-cta i { font-size: 13px; }

    /* ─── RECOMMENDED READS ──────────────────────────────────── */
    .reads-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .reads-tab {
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 40px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      background: white;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }
    .reads-tab:hover { color: var(--teal); border-color: var(--teal-mid); background: var(--teal-light); }
    .reads-tab.active {
      color: white;
      background: var(--teal);
      border-color: var(--teal);
    }
    .reads-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .article-card {
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .article-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-3px); }
    .article-img {
      height: 160px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .article-img i { font-size: 52px; opacity: 0.55; }
    .article-cat {
      position: absolute;
      top: 10px; left: 10px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: white;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 40px;
    }
    .article-body { padding: 16px; flex: 1; }
    .article-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .article-card:hover .article-title { color: var(--teal); }
    .article-meta {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .article-meta i { font-size: 13px; }

    /* Color variants for article images */
    .ai-fitness   { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E6F5F6, var(--teal-mid)); }
    .ai-fitness i { color: var(--teal-dark); }
    .ai-nutrition { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D1FAE5, #A7F3D0); }
    .ai-nutrition i { color: #065F46; }
    .ai-mental    { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EDE9FE, #DDD6FE); }
    .ai-mental i  { color: #7C3AED; }
    .ai-products  { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FEF3C7, #FDE68A); }
    .ai-products i { color: #D97706; }
    .ai-skin      { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FCE7F3, #FBCFE8); }
    .ai-skin i    { color: #BE185D; }
    .ai-health    { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE4E6, #FECDD3); }
    .ai-health i  { color: #E11D48; }

    .tab-panel { display: none; }
    .tab-panel.active { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; }

    /* ─── TRUST SECTION ──────────────────────────────────────── */
    .trust-section {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #F8FAFB 0%, #EFF5F6 100%);
      padding: 72px 0;
    }
    .trust-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 52px; }
    .trust-header h2 {
      font-size: 30px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      letter-spacing: -0.4px;
      max-width: 540px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }
    .trust-header h2 span { color: var(--teal); }
    .trust-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .trust-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px 24px;
      text-align: center;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }
    .trust-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .trust-icon {
      width: 64px; height: 64px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--teal-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
      border: 2px solid var(--teal-mid);

    .trust-icon i { font-size: 28px; color: var(--teal); }
    .trust-card h3 { font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--charcoal); margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .trust-card p { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--gray-500); line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ─── FEATURED PROGRAMS ──────────────────────────────────── */
    .programs-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .program-card {
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);

      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }
    .program-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-3px); }
    .program-img {
      height: 140px;

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .program-img i { font-size: 56px; opacity: 0.6; }
    .pi-skin    { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FCE7F3, #FBCFE8); }
    .pi-skin i  { color: #BE185D; }
    .pi-ms      { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E6F5F6, var(--teal-mid)); }
    .pi-ms i    { color: var(--teal-dark); }
    .pi-eczema  { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FEF3C7, #FDE68A); }
    .pi-eczema i { color: #D97706; }
    .pi-men     { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EFF6FF, #DBEAFE); }
    .pi-men i   { color: #1D4ED8; }
    .program-body { padding: 16px; }
    .program-tag {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 6px;

    .program-title { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--charcoal); line-height: 1.4; }
    .program-card:hover .program-title { color: var(--teal); }

    /* ─── LATEST VIDEOS ──────────────────────────────────────── */

      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .video-card {
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);

      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }
    .video-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-3px); }

      height: 150px;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;

      justify-content: center;

    .vi-fitness  { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E6F5F6, var(--teal-mid)); }
    .vi-fitness .bg-icon  { color: var(--teal-dark); }
    .vi-skin     { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FCE7F3, #FBCFE8); }
    .vi-skin .bg-icon     { color: #BE185D; }
    .vi-neuro    { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EDE9FE, #DDD6FE); }
    .vi-neuro .bg-icon    { color: #7C3AED; }
    .vi-immune   { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF7ED, #FED7AA); }
    .vi-immune .bg-icon   { color: #C2410C; }
    .play-btn {
      position: absolute;
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      transition: transform 0.15s, background 0.15s;

      bottom: 8px; right: 8px;

      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 2px 6px;

    .video-body { padding: 14px 16px; }
    .video-cat {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .video-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--charcoal); line-height: 1.4; }
    .video-card:hover .video-title { color: var(--teal); }

    .footer-top { padding: 56px 0 40px; }

      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

    .footer-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);

      padding: 4px 4px 4px 20px;

    }
    .footer-form input {
      flex: 1;
      background: none;

      font-family: inherit;
    }
    .footer-form input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); }
    .btn-signup {
      padding: 10px 22px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: white;
      border-radius: 40px;

<script>
  // ── Recommended Reads Tabs ──────────────────────────────────
  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.reads-tab');
  const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel');

  tabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const target = tab.dataset.tab;

      tabs.forEach(t => {
        t.classList.remove('active');
        t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
      });
      panels.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));

      tab.classList.add('active');
      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      const panel = document.getElementById('tab-' + target);
      if (panel) panel.classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  // ── Health Topics Carousel ──────────────────────────────────
  const track = document.getElementById('topicsTrack');
  const prev  = document.getElementById('topicsPrev');
  const next  = document.getElementById('topicsNext');
  const SCROLL = 160;

  prev.addEventListener('click', () => track.scrollBy({ left: -SCROLL, behavior: 'smooth' }));
  next.addEventListener('click', () => track.scrollBy({ left:  SCROLL, behavior: 'smooth' }));

  // ── Newsletter forms (prevent default) ─────────────────────
  document.querySelectorAll('.form-row, .footer-form').forEach(form => {
    const btn = form.querySelector('button');
    if (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
        if (input && input.value.trim()) {
          btn.textContent = 'Subscribed!';
          btn.style.background = '#27AE60';
          input.value = '';
          setTimeout(() => {
            btn.textContent = btn.classList.contains('btn-join') ? 'Join Now' : 'Sign Up';
            btn.style.background = '';
          }, 3000);
        }
      });
    }
  });

    }
    .btn-signin {

    /* ─── HERO ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.03'%3E%3Cpath d='M36 34v-4h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2h-4zm0-30V0h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2V6h4V4h-4zM6 34v-4H4v4H0v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2H6zM6 4V0H4v4H0v2h4v4h2V6h4V4H6z'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    }
    .hero-inner {

    }
    .hero-content { padding-bottom: 64px; }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      padding: 5px 14px;
      border-radius: 40px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;

      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero-badge i { font-size: 13px; color: var(--amber); }
    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 520px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: white;
      color: var(--teal);
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: 40px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    }
    .hero-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }
    .hero-challenge-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl) 0 0;
      padding: 28px 28px 0;
      box-shadow: 0 -8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      align-self: end;
    }
    .challenge-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: var(--teal-light);

      padding: 5px 12px;
      border-radius: 40px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .challenge-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 200px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e6f5f6 0%, #b3dde0 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .challenge-img-inner {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--teal);
    }
    .challenge-img-inner i { font-size: 56px; opacity: 0.7; }
    .challenge-day {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
      opacity: 0.8;
    }
    .challenge-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      margin-top: 14px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .challenge-progress {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 12px;
      padding-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .progress-bar {
      flex: 1;
      height: 5px;
      background: var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 40px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .progress-fill {
      width: 40%;

    }
    .progress-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-500); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ─── TRENDING ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .trending-section {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      padding: 28px 0;
    }
    .trending-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .trending-label {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: var(--coral);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .trending-label i { font-size: 15px; }
    .trending-divider {
      width: 1px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--gray-300);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .trending-list {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .trending-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 40px;
      transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
    }
    .trending-item:hover { border-color: var(--teal-mid); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }

    }
    .trending-title { font-size: 13px; color: var(--charcoal-light); font-weight: 400; }

    /* ─── NEWSLETTER CTA ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .newsletter-cta {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-dark) 0%, var(--teal) 100%);
      padding: 56px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

      content: '';

      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }
    .newsletter-cta::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -60px; left: -60px;
      width: 240px; height: 240px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    }
    .newsletter-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 48px;
    }
    .newsletter-text { flex: 1; }
    .newsletter-text h2 {
      font-size: 28px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
    }

      font-size: 16px;

    .btn-join {
      padding: 10px 22px;

      color: white;
      border-radius: 40px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .btn-join:hover { background: #d4563a; transform: scale(1.02); }
    .privacy-note {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
    }
    .privacy-note i { font-size: 13px; }

    /* ─── HEALTH TOPICS ──────────────────────────────────────── */
    .section { padding: 64px 0; }

      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: 26px;

    .view-all {
      display: flex;

      justify-content: center;

    .tc-anxiety   .topic-circle-bg i { color: #7C3AED; }
    .tc-digestive .topic-circle-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FEF3C7, #FDE68A); }

    .tc-heart     .topic-circle-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE4E6, #FECDCd); }
    .tc-heart     .topic-circle-bg i { color: #E11D48; }
    .tc-menopause .topic-circle-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FCE7F3, #FBCFE8); }
    .tc-menopause .topic-circle-bg i { color: #BE185D; }
    .tc-diabetes  .topic-circle-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E6F5F6, var(--teal-mid)); }
    .tc-diabetes  .topic-circle-bg i { color: var(--teal-dark); }
    .tc-weight    .topic-circle-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D1FAE5, #A7F3D0); }
    .tc-weight    .topic-circle-bg i { color: #065F46; }

    .topic-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .topic-card:hover .topic-label { color: var(--teal); }

    .carousel-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: white;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      color: var(--charcoal);

      transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, transform 0.15s;

      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

      width: 52px; height: 52px;

      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 12px 14px;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }
    .nutrition-tool-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); }
    .nutrition-tool-item i { font-size: 18px; opacity: 0.85; }
    .nutrition-tool-text strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; display: block; }
    .nutrition-tool-text span { font-size: 12.5px; opacity: 0.75; }

      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);

    }
    .drug-tool-icon i { font-size: 20px; }

    .icon-teal i { color: var(--teal); }
    .icon-amber { background: #FEF3C7; }
    .icon-amber i { color: #D97706; }
    .icon-coral { background: #FFF1EE; }

      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .drug-tool-cta i { font-size: 13px; }

      font-size: 30px;

      letter-spacing: -0.4px;

    .trust-header h2 span { color: var(--teal); }
    .trust-grid {

<script>
  // ── Recommended Reads Tabs ──────────────────────────────────
  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.reads-tab');
  const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel');

  tabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const target = tab.dataset.tab;

      tabs.forEach(t => {
        t.classList.remove('active');
        t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
      });
      panels.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));

      tab.classList.add('active');
      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      const panel = document.getElementById('tab-' + target);
      if (panel) panel.classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  // ── Health Topics Carousel ──────────────────────────────────
  const track = document.getElementById('topicsTrack');
  const prev  = document.getElementById('topicsPrev');
  const next  = document.getElementById('topicsNext');
  const SCROLL = 160;

  prev.addEventListener('click', () => track.scrollBy({ left: -SCROLL, behavior: 'smooth' }));
  next.addEventListener('click', () => track.scrollBy({ left:  SCROLL, behavior: 'smooth' }));

  // ── Newsletter forms (prevent default) ─────────────────────
  document.querySelectorAll('.form-row, .footer-form').forEach(form => {
    const btn = form.querySelector('button');
    if (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
        if (input && input.value.trim()) {
          btn.textContent = 'Subscribed!';
          btn.style.background = '#27AE60';
          input.value = '';
          setTimeout(() => {
            btn.textContent = btn.classList.contains('btn-join') ? 'Join Now' : 'Sign Up';
            btn.style.background = '';
          }, 3000);
        }
      });
    }
  });
</script>
</body>

    /* ─── TICKER ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  // ── Recommended Reads Tabs ──────────────────────────────────
  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.reads-tab');
  const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel');

  tabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const target = tab.dataset.tab;

      tabs.forEach(t => {
        t.classList.remove('active');
        t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
      });
      panels.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));

      tab.classList.add('active');
      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      const panel = document.getElementById('tab-' + target);
      if (panel) panel.classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  // ── Health Topics Carousel ──────────────────────────────────
  const track = document.getElementById('topicsTrack');
  const prev  = document.getElementById('topicsPrev');
  const next  = document.getElementById('topicsNext');
  const SCROLL = 160;

  prev.addEventListener('click', () => track.scrollBy({ left: -SCROLL, behavior: 'smooth' }));
  next.addEventListener('click', () => track.scrollBy({ left:  SCROLL, behavior: 'smooth' }));

  // ── Newsletter forms (prevent default) ─────────────────────
  document.querySelectorAll('.form-row, .footer-form').forEach(form => {

        const input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
        if (input && input.value.trim()) {
          btn.textContent = 'Subscribed!';
          btn.style.background = '#27AE60';
          input.value = '';
          setTimeout(() => {
            btn.textContent = btn.classList.contains('btn-join') ? 'Join Now' : 'Sign Up';
            btn.style.background = '';
          }, 3000);
        }
      });
    }
  });
</script>
